title: Builder Space daily AI news edition

date.description: Sydney calendar date of the edition

edition_id.description: date for the default edition (news/<date>.json), date-<label> for labelled ones (news/<date>-<label>.json), e.g. 2026-10-11-noon

tone.description: Rendering tone of message_text; cute = playful + emoji, one quip per item (v2). Absent in legacy editions

tag.description: Edition tag, also the LAST line of message_text, e.g. #BS-1011 or #BS-1011-noon. Absent only in legacy editions

items.description: Exactly 5; at most 2 with org other (enforced by scripts/newslib.py)

aside_zh.description: One playful quip per item, required for tone=cute, 1-3 emoji; never states facts, no digits/links/brackets

title_emoji.description: 1-2 emoji appended to the title in tone=cute (required there)

origin.description: Candidate pool; x+aihot when the same event was found in both

aihot_url.description: AIHOT reading page (story page preferred); aihot.news only, aihot.virxact.com retires 2026-10-31

aihot_rank.description: Rank in /api/v1/hot-topics at generation time (AIHOT has no numeric heat score)

message_text.description: Full ready-to-send plain-text WeChat message; first line is the header

content_sha256.description: sha256 hex of message_text encoded as UTF-8
